pattern.description: The cursor moves from the Copy link popover to the sidebar and clicks 'Timeline view'; the popover closes and the whole content area cuts to the Timeline view while the sidebar row takes the selected outline.
pattern.why_premium: The click lands in the narration pause right before 'Now using a timeline view', so the view arrives just as it is named. The persistent sidebar keeps the viewer oriented across the hard swap.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: gsap.to(cursor, {x, y, duration:0.5, ease:'power2.inOut'}); then at click tl.set('.share-popover', {autoAlpha:0}).set('.view-roadmap', {autoAlpha:0}).set('.view-timeline', {autoAlpha:1}).set('.nav-timeline', {className:'+=selected'}); a 0.1s opacity fromTo would soften it but the source is a hard step.
build_hint.remotion: Move the cursor with spring({frame, fps, config:{damping:200}}) to the sidebar row; switch views with a frame threshold (frame >= clickFrame) rather than interpolate; no spring on the swap.

notes: Screen-recorded navigation; the content change is an instant swap (energy peaks on two frames). The 'Copied' toast stays static. The cursor sits inside b04 so it is not listed separately.
